editorial.blurb: Ramen Wasabi brings world-class noodle bowls and crispy gyozas to Fulton Market with reliable, craveable execution that keeps diners coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit their happy hour until 6:30pm for great cocktail and appetizer pricing, and ask for the Spicy Roasted Garlic Miso or Miso Kimchi Ramen—the broth is consistently rich and the noodles are perfectly chewy.
